name: Cursor
removalRules: CLI conversations, CLI versions, and workspace state stay protected. Verified Electron caches and linked Git worktrees use the existing review controls.
note: Cursor advises deleting chats through History, and CLI conversations have no cloud backup, so Moppo never edits `state.vscdb` or removes CLI sessions.
